description.value: Canada Place is an iconic waterfront complex in downtown Vancouver, originally constructed as the Canadian Pavilion for Expo 86 and now home to a cruise ship terminal, convention centre, and the FlyOver Canada attraction. Operated by the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority, it anchors the northern end of Vancouver's famous seawall and offers sweeping views of Burrard Inlet and the North Shore mountains. Touring cyclists arriving via the seawall will find it a natural and prominent waypoint at the heart of the city's waterfront.
